critique: The energy visualization system shows strong conceptual clarity with its chronological time-block mapping, but the behavioral layer suffers from poor visual hierarchy—the tiny, uniformly-sized blocks make pattern recognition nearly impossible despite the thoughtful color-coding system. The crafted details like the legend and clean typography can't overcome the fundamental gestalt problem where critical information (peak vs. valley energy states) gets lost in a sea of undifferentiated rectangles, undermining the calendar's core utility of helping users plan around their energy patterns.
